# IAssetsForwarderErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/utils/AssetsForwarder/IAssetsForwarderErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IAssetsForwarderErrors

Interface for the AssetsForwarder errors


## Errors
### InvalidTargetAddress
Thrown when the specified target address is the zero address


```solidity
error InvalidTargetAddress();
```

### InvalidAssetAddress
Thrown when the specified asset is the zero address


```solidity
error InvalidAssetAddress();
```

### ZeroAmount
Thrown when the specified amount is zero


```solidity
error ZeroAmount();
```
